title: Where the Return Days of a Coverage Return Start
content:
Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), the return days of a coverage return run to the coverage's expiration date. The expiration date is counted and the starting day is not. The starting day is:
- **Totaled vehicle, owner paid.** When the latest claim (the coverage's claim with the highest claim number) records a total loss declaration and a total loss payment to the named insured stands on it, the return days start from that claim's date of loss, since the totaled vehicle had no exposure after it.
- **Inspection still pending.** When the coverage is still awaiting its photo inspection and no total loss payment to the named insured stands on its latest claim, they start from the coverage effective date, so that every premium day charged comes back.
- **Otherwise.** They start from today.

### Hypothetical dates, for a coverage expiring on 30 June

| Situation on the records | Start | Return days |
|---|---|---|
| Total loss declared on the latest claim, date of loss 18 April, total loss payment made to the named insured | 18 April | 73 |
| Coverage effective 2 May, still awaiting inspection, no total loss payment to the named insured | 2 May | 59 |
| Neither, removal asked for on 11 May | 11 May | 50 |
